verdict.rationale: Bruno is an API client, not an LLM/MCP gateway, but it does offer BYOK AI features and an Ultimate-tier admin control that lets License Administrators govern which AI providers/models are allowed and how requests are protected, which is a thin form of provider governance. There is no evidence of token-limit enforcement, prompt guarding, or MCP traffic proxying/routing. missing for 10: token/usage limit controls, prompt-injection/prompt guard mechanisms, MCP traffic proxying, multi-provider routing/load-balancing, independent verification of the admin governance feature.
